title: Report of the Special Rapporteur on the Negative Impact of Unilateral Coercive Measures on the Enjoyment of Human Rights on Her Mission to the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela
publisher_or_archive: United Nations General Assembly / Human Rights Council (A/HRC/48/59/Add.2)
summary: Official United Nations report finding that US and Western unilateral sectoral sanctions against Venezuela's oil sector, financial transactions, and central bank assets exacerbated existing economic distress into a catastrophic humanitarian crisis, severely impairing the right to health, food, water, and life for the general population.
